title: Conquest of SkyrimNet
tagline: Choose a government, raise an army, conquer territory and manage your economy with the end goal being to become the High King of Skyrim
description:
# Conquest of SkyrimNet

Conquest of SkyrimNet is an ambitious mod that allows the player to create their own faction independent of the
Stormcloaks and the Empire. The player can choose a government, raise an army, conquer territory and manage their
economy with the end goal being to become the High King of Skyrim. DON'T START THIS IN THE MIDDLE OF THE CIVIL WAR

Found your own faction in Skyrim, rule its holds, lead its armies and run its treasury, mostly by **talking to
people**. Conquest of SkyrimNet builds on Conquest of Skyrim and adds a government you speak to through
SkyrimNet, along with a PrismaUI faction screen, requests from your
people, unrest and uprisings, army morale, deserters, bribery and coups, and settlements you build yourself.

THIS WAS MADE USING THE ORIGINAL CODE OF CONQUEST OF SKYRIM, AUTHORED BY **GALVATRON530**.

> **New here?** Skip down to What to say, and to whom. You don't need exact
> wording: say what you mean in your own words. The NPC decides whether to act, and anything that costs gold or
> can't be undone asks you to confirm first.

---

## Requirements

| Required | Link |
|---|---|
| Skyrim SE/AE with SKSE64 | skse. |
| PapyrusUtil | Nexus Mods |
| SkyUI + MCM Helper | SkyUI · MCM Helper |
| **PrismaUI**: the faction screen | Nexus Mods |
| **SkyrimNet**: Conversation, knowledge and memories | Nexus Mods |

| Optional / recommended | Link | What it adds |
|---|---|---|
| **Physical Letters** | GitHub | Requests reach you as letters by courier. |
| **SeverActions** (recommended) | GitHub | More SkyrimNet actions, so NPCs can follow you, travel, craft, change outfits, make arrests and fight. It pairs well with the faction's officers and soldiers. |

Conquest of SkyrimNet **replaces** Conquest of Skyrim (`conquerskyrim.esp`), so remove that first.

## Install

1. Install `ConquestOfSkyrimNet_v<version>.zip` with your mod manager and enable `ConquestOfSkyrimNet.esp`.
2. In the installer, keep **SkyrimNet knowledge** ticked if you use SkyrimNet.
3. Start a new game, or continue a save made with an earlier version of Conquest of SkyrimNet.
4. Read the **Start my Faction** book to pick your faction's name, army prefix and banner.
5. Go to MCM > Conquest of SkyrimNet > General and bind **Faction menu**. It's unbound by default.
## Your first hour

1. **Found your faction** with the book.
2. **Take a claim.** Clear a bandit camp, a mine or a fort and plant your banner (see Taking claims).
3. **Appoint a Steward.** Ask a friendly NPC: *"I need someone to run my treasury. Will you be my Steward?"*
4. **Appoint a General**, and a **Captain** for your first army.
5. **Open the faction screen** with your hotkey. It shows your treasury, supplies, lands, armies and requests.
6. From then on, run the realm by talking to the people who serve you.

## Credits

Built on **Conquest of Skyrim**. Conversation through SkyrimNet. Menus by
PrismaUI. Letters by Physical Letters.
Recommended companion: SeverActions.

changelog:
# Conquest of SkyrimNet: changes since 1.9.9 (2.0.0 to 2.1.15)


## Settlements

- Build from the faction screen: a catalogue with costs and what each building gives (unaffordable ones greyed out), grid and angle snapping, and ready-made layouts (starter camp, farmstead, lumber camp, mining camp, outpost, market square) shown in outline before you place them.
- Move or take down any building, nearest first. Storage chests, strongboxes and a weapon rack. Every building adds beds, food, wood, metal or gold; tents come with bedrolls; the lumber mill has its log pile and working saw.

## Armies and war

- Troop upkeep: every troop and claim or settlement guard is paid daily (MCM > Economy), with an upkeep table per army.
- Armies sent against an uprising or deserters really march there (walking or running, as to a garrison or an attack), and fight when they arrive.
- Peace talks: ask your Steward or a jarl, or press *Peace talks…* on the War sub-tab; the enemy leader comes to your palace under truce.

## Government and officers

- **Thanes:** name Thanes in holds you control (1,000 gold, 3 per hold plus one per settlement). They wear their hold's Thane outfit and, as one of their privileges, bring you private ventures to invest in, in conversation or by request. A hold whose capital you lose loses its Thanes.
- Jarls act with your Steward's full authority for any of your towns, and know every town's stores.

## Economy and towns

- Lands and the Steward's books are one tab: each town is a card with gold, food, metal and wood tiles showing stores and daily surplus or deficit.
- Town gold moves as a daily flow, like food, metal and wood (Take / Send / Set on the Gold tile). Jarls who manage a town's economy balance its gold too.
- Thane ventures pay their gold into the hold's city treasury; hover the Gold tile for every venture running there, its gold a day and days left. Losing the city deletes them.
